qa_pairs.question: What is the BMW part number for replacing the trunk floor plate on a convertible?
qa_pairs.answer: The part number is 41 12 570 for replacing the trunk floor plate (partial replacement in front of cross member) with tail panel removed on convertible models.

qa_pairs.question: What page should you refer to for additional information before starting this trunk floor plate repair?
qa_pairs.answer: You should refer to information on page 41-001 before beginning the repair work.

qa_pairs.question: What precaution must be taken regarding car parts in the repair area?
qa_pairs.answer: You must remove or cover up all car parts which are located in the repair area or subjected to heat, sparks and dust.

qa_pairs.question: Where should the trunk floor plate be cut off from the wheel house?
qa_pairs.answer: Cut off the trunk floor plate from the wheel house on both the left and right sides.

qa_pairs.question: What needs to be made accessible before marking cutting lines?
qa_pairs.answer: Make left and right connections accessible before proceeding with the cutting line marking process.

qa_pairs.question: Where should the cutting lines be marked for the transition area?
qa_pairs.answer: Mark cutting lines at height of transition on left and right sides.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done to the spot welds on the left and right sides?
qa_pairs.answer: Drill out spot welds on left and right sides to remove the connections.

qa_pairs.question: How far toward the rear should spot welds be drilled out on the side members?
qa_pairs.answer: Drill out spot welds on side members forward up to cutting line and approx. 80 mm (3.150") toward rear.

qa_pairs.question: What must be done to make spot welding accessible during reassembly?
qa_pairs.answer: Make left and right spot welding accessible and drill out spot welds to prepare for new welding connections.

qa_pairs.question: What should be done to prepare connections for welding?
qa_pairs.answer: Make connections accessible and drill out spot welds to prepare the surfaces for new welding.

qa_pairs.question: What image reference number shows the cutting line marking procedure?
qa_pairs.answer: Image reference number 30 41 607 shows the procedure for marking cutting lines at the height of transition.

qa_pairs.question: What does image reference 30 41 258 demonstrate?
qa_pairs.answer: Image reference 30 41 258 shows making left and right spot welding accessible and drilling out spot welds.
